CharacterStats.title: CharacterStats
CharacterStats.description: Public interaction counters for a character profile (hearts and comments).

characterId.description: Unique slug identifier of the character.

likesCount.description: Total number of hearts received by this character.

commentsCount.description: Total number of active public comments on this character.

lastCommentId.description: Comment document ID modified in the latest atomic batch.

isPublic.description: Public visibility flag required for list queries.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest counter update.

CharacterComment.title: CharacterComment
CharacterComment.description: Public comment posted by an authenticated visitor using their chosen display nickname.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the comment author.

authorName.description: Chosen display nickname shown publicly next to the comment.

likesCount.description: Total hearts received by this comment.

lastLikeId.description: CommentLike document ID toggled in the latest atomic batch.

isPublic.description: Public visibility flag required for list queries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the comment was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the comment was last updated.

CharacterLike.title: CharacterLike
CharacterLike.description: Per-user heart record for a character (deterministic ID: {characterId}__{uid}).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who liked the character.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the heart was added.

CommentLike.title: CommentLike
CommentLike.description: Per-user heart record for a specific comment (deterministic ID: {commentId}__{uid}).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who liked the comment.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the comment heart was added.

/characterStats/{characterId}/comments/{.description: Public comments subcollection for each character.

/likes/{likeId}.description: Private per-user character heart records keyed by {characterId}__{uid}.

/commentLikes/{commentLikeId}.description: Private per-user comment heart records keyed by {commentId}__{uid}.
